name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including configurable utility packages and an optional /etc/motd, along with supporting custom facts, functions, types, and operational assets.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys and configures a Python application stack with PostgreSQL connectivity, dependencies, application content, environment files, a hardened systemd Gunicorn service, and operational monitoring resources.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures HAProxy load balancers with generated frontend and backend settings, optional TLS termination, statistics and error pages, firewall integration, health checks, and optional dynamic discovery.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL, including repository management, versioned packages, libpq-dev, and ordered service startup; PostgreSQL 15 is the intended version.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis through the puppet-redis module, including networking, authentication, persistence, memory limits, and eviction policy, with supporting cluster-member discovery.

name: profile composition layer
description: Provides thin profile wrappers that compose base, application, HAProxy, and Redis services and define the class contract used by higher-level roles.

name: role composition layer
description: Defines node-level compositions for application servers, full application stacks, HAProxy nodes, and Redis cluster nodes, including dependencies and ordering between profiles.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Provides a custom puppetdb_query Ruby function used by Redis and HAProxy discovery code, requiring replacement with Ansible inventory or another service-discovery mechanism.
